draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.85, the 196th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 24th of 32 at WR. He lasted until pick 253, well after his grade rank (196th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (19th percentile), broad jump (18th percentile). College production: 889 receiving yards in 2022, 16th of 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 28 career games and 0 starts over 3 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (5th percentile). Played 2 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 wide receiver who played: 23 receiving yards against a median of 346, below the norm.
